data.name: Daudiyah
data.gender_notes: Daudiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A female name derived from the name of Prophet David (Dawud) in Arabic language. The name Daudiyah carries the meaning “Servant of David” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daudiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of david and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of faith and strength, derived from the name of the Prophet David.
data.etymology: Daudiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of David.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daudiyah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: داودية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من داود عليه السلام، يعني محبة الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: داودية هو اسم علم مؤنث، مشتق من اسم النبي داود عليه السلام، والذي يعني محبة الله تعالى. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني دينية وروحانية عميقة، حيث يرتبط بالتقوى والإيمان بالله. استخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كتعبير عن الإجلال والاحترام للنبي داود.

in_urdu.name: داؤدیہ
in_urdu.meaning: داؤد علیہ السلام سے ماخوذ، اللہ کی محبت کا مطلب
in_urdu.long_meaning: داؤدیہ ایک علم اسم ہے، جو نبی داؤد علیہ السلام کے نام سے لیا گیا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی محبت یا اللہ کا پیارا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافتوں میں بڑے احترام کے ساتھ استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر اس کے تعلق کی وجہ سے نبی داؤد کے ساتھ، جو قرآن میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام روحانی پاکیزگی اور تقوى کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दाऊदीया

in_hindi.long_meaning: दाऊदीया एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है, जो पैगंबर दाऊद अलैहिस्सलाम से लिया गया है। यह नाम भगवान की प्रेमिका या दाऊद के समान प्रिय होने के अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम बहुत सम्मान और पवित्रता के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है, क्योंकि यह एक महान पैगंबर के नाम से जुड़ा है।

in_english.name: Daudiyah
in_english.meaning: Derived from Daud, meaning beloved of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Daudiyah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic name of the Prophet Daud (David), which means 'beloved of Allah' or 'loved by God'. This name is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition and culture, symbolizing a strong spiritual connection with Allah. It reflects the values of devotion, righteousness, and piety associated with Prophet Daud, who is mentioned in the Quran. The name Daudiyah carries a sense of reverence and sanctity, making it a cherished choice for many Muslim families worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: Daudiyah is a beautiful name with a rich cultural and historical significance rooted in Islamic tradition. The name pays homage to one of the most revered prophets in Islam, Prophet David (Dawud). Prophet David was a messenger of Allah and a significant figure in the Old Testament of the Bible, known for his wisdom, strength, and piety. The name Daudiyah reflects the deep respect and devotion towards this holiest of men, whose legacy continues to inspire generations of Muslims.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Daudiyah holds great spiritual significance for Muslims as it is a constant reminder of the vital lessons and teachings imparted by Prophet David. He was a humble servant of Allah who fulfilled his duties with utmost sincerity and devotion. The spiritual values instilled in the name Daudiyah are honesty, integrity, dedication, strong faith, and unwavering loyalty to Allah. These values guide the bearer of this name to lead a life worthy of emulation, aligning her spiritual journey with the footsteps of the noble Prophet David (Dawud).
